name: WPA Institute Proactive Agent Fabric
purpose: Server-side, source-disciplined multi-agent orchestration for WPA Institute research, editorial preparation, institutional analysis and governed automation.

agents.label: Grok-Bot-Proactive Agent
agents.mission: Detect public signals, dissenting interpretations, emerging issues and counter-narratives for later verification.

agents.label: GPT Orchestrator
agents.mission: Build task plans, route evidence, synthesize bounded outputs and maintain handoff records.

agents.label: Claude Red-Team Agent
agents.mission: Challenge assumptions, identify contradictions, test evidence sufficiency and review academic/institutional quality.

agents.label: Kimi Long-Context Agent
agents.mission: Compare larger source packets, preserve cross-document context and produce multilingual comparison notes.

agents.label: Harvey Legal-Compliance Agent
agents.mission: Provide bounded legal/compliance issue spotting when an authorised Harvey-compatible server adapter is configured.
agents.boundary: No claim of Harvey API availability, partnership or legal authority is made by this manifest.

human_gate.HG0: Automatic informational and reversible tasks allowed.
human_gate.HG1: Automatic bounded research, routing, comparison, drafting and queue preparation allowed under mandate.
human_gate.HG2: Publication, official statements, material corrections and external deliverables must stop at READY_FOR_HUMAN_GATE.
human_gate.HG3: Legal/financial/privacy/credential-sensitive actions require secure private backend and human preapproval.
human_gate.HG4: Doctrine, mandate, new institutional authority and official commitments are human-only final decisions.

default_pipeline: Harvey legal/compliance issue spotting when configured
non_claims: This release candidate does not mean all five external providers are connected.
A configured seat does not imply partnership, endorsement or provider participation.
The system does not autonomously publish, bind WPA, change doctrine, issue credentials or make legal decisions.
